biggest_catch: Streetbees no longer exists — the company entered administration in August 2025 and the app shut down. You cannot earn from it at all.
catches: Streetbees entered administration in August 2025 after failing to secure rescue funding or a buyer (Sky News via businesscloud.co.uk; research-live.com).
The Streetbees app has shut down and is 'no longer available to use' (householdmoneysaving.com, reviewed 178 days ago).
Do not sign up or install — there is nothing to earn here.

c1.evidence: Streetbees was a real global market-research task app, but it collapsed: 'Streetbees confirms that it has now entered administration' (Sky News, Aug 2025); app shut down.

notes: Dead app per hard rule. Formerly a $2/task-ish chat-style market research app paying via PayPal. Documented collapse Aug 2025.
